headline: Live-to-Testing Gate Framework: 4-metric decision criteria + weekly learnings sync to prevent premature campaign escalation
highlights: Testing phase duration: 7–14 days with clear Day 7 checkpoint
4 success metrics (all must be met): Response rate ≥30%, Objection rate <40%, Pilot intent ≥1, Email open rate ≥40%
Go/No-Go logic: SCALE to 50+ prospects, ITERATE fresh 10-prospect cohort, or PAUSE & PIVOT strategy
Single decision authority: Outreach Lead (Founder or Head of Growth) makes unilateral call on Day 7
Weekly learnings sync: 30-min Monday standup with Founder + Product Lead to track metrics, objections, product blockers
Escalation path: 48-hour extension for borderline decisions (metric exactly at threshold)
18-column response tracker: All sends, opens, replies, objections logged systematically
Objection taxonomy: Hard vs. Soft classification criteria with sales counters and severity levels
Live campaign success metrics: ≥25% response rate, ≥4% pilot conversion, <30% hard objection rate
Post-campaign learning: Data archival, Founder decision memo, GTM playbook updates with winning templates
